thread:
sara: starting coordinated deploy for the 03:00 UTC change window. pinning versions: runtime=v2.4.1, api=v1.9.0, console=canary-190, router=v3.0.0-rc2. rollout plan: router -> runtime -> api -> console (console will be canary 20% for 15m). rollback criteria: global 5xx >5% over 5m OR p95 latency >200ms AND error budget burn >2x. tagging @eli @june for monitoring. release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/2026-03-21/notes

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for 2026-03-21T03:00:00Z. preflight checks passed in staging. locks acquired for cross-service cutover.

tom: quick question - api has a dependency on the runtime kv-eviction tweak in v2.4.1. runtime team confirmed compatibility but noted slightly different cache warmup. sequence wise i suggest router -> runtime -> api -> console.

eli: console team will enable feature flag console.new_ui_canary -> 20% for 30m during the window. dashboards: redwood/console/canary and infra/latency-p95 are ready. i'll watch panels and slack alerts.

june: ops suggestion: roll by region: us-east-1, us-west-1 first, eu-west-1 last. if eu-west spikes we can do a targeted region rollback instead of global.

sara: ack. updating runbook to reflect regional sequencing and per-region rollback steps. tom, can you add a temporary alert that pages for >5% 5xx over 5m per region?

tom: done. pushed temporary alert rule to prod-alerts: 
```
alert: CanaryErrorRateHigh
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{service=~"api|runtime|router"}[5m])) by (region, service)
 / sum(rate(http_requests_total{service=~"api|runtime|router"}[5m])) by (region) > 0.05
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
```

Pager: oncall rotation set.

deploy-bot: deploy started: router rollout (v3.0.0-rc2) 80% -> 100% across us-east-1/us-west-1. logs: /deploys/1719543210/router

deploy-bot: router rollout complete. runtime canary starting in us-east-1 (v2.4.1) at 03:06 UTC, initial traffic split 10%.

eli: heads up - after runtime canary we see p95 in eu-west-1 creeping up to 320ms on some traces. not all regions, but tail latency spike is visible.

june: metrics show ~4.8% 5xx in eu-west-1 across runtime+api. recommend targeted rollback of runtime in eu-west-1 and hold console canary.

sara: do the targeted rollback for eu-west-1 runtime. do not touch router or api traffic routing yet.

deploy-bot: rollback executed: runtime eu-west-1 -> v2.3.9 at 2026-03-21T03:12:34Z. rollback job: /deploys/1719543210/rollback-eu-west-1-runtime

tom: after rollback p95 in eu-west-1 dropped back to ~120ms and 5xx fell to 0.6%. looks stable. resuming broader canary steps but we'll keep runtime eu-west-1 pinned to v2.3.9 until extended perf tests finish.

eli: filing follow-up perf ticket INF-3421: reproduce high tail latencies under seq_len=4096 and cross-region replication scenarios. console team should hold canary until fixed.

sara: notes for release: partial rollback performed (runtime in eu-west-1) at 03:12:34 UTC for latency/5xx spike. otherwise router=3.0.0-rc2 is live global, api v1.9.0 rolled canary->50%, console canary held. next steps: runtime team to run extended perf runs and share results in this thread. i'll author post-release notes and annotate rollback timeline.

june: :thumbsup: closing the change window early; will continue monitoring dashboards for 1h.

deploy-bot: change window closed at 2026-03-21T03:25:00Z. final status summary: router=3.0.0-rc2 (global), runtime=v2.4.1 (global except eu-west-1 -> v2.3.9), api=v1.9.0 (canary progressing), console=canary-190 (held).
